event.description: Constrain the shared feed-forward output map to be symmetric
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 42 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0095/micro-0001 at 1,672 parameters/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0127, whose symmetric FF input map scored 0.00% at 1,572 parameters. Hypothesis: directed feature construction is essential, but residual reconstruction after GELU may tolerate reciprocal feature geometry. Preserve the current 236-group input transform exactly, constrain only the 16x16 output transform to a learned symmetric matrix initialized by transpose-pair averaging, and retain width 16, yielding 1,581 parameters. This is more informative than a triangular output map because it is the exact input/output complement of attempt-0127 at comparable capacity and tests geometry without deleting one direction outright.
